column4: Ruhunu  Awakening  Organization
(Incorporation)
to identify inborn talents of students and youths at
the rural, district and provincial levels in the fields
of  sports,  literary  and  arts  and  to  inspire  them  to
harness  their  inborn  talents  through  the  provision
of  the  required  infrastructure  facilities  for  this
purpose;
to  provide  for  displaying  and  evalating  skills  of
school children and university students and to confer
awards  and  certificates  to  children  with  talents  in
order to promote their cultural skills;
to  implement  special  training  programmes  which
will enable the creation of a young generation who
appreciate and practice values, norms and ethics;
to implement practical programmes for promoting
physical capabilities of student population through
sanitation and health programmes and sports cum
physical exercise programmes;

to  organize  and  operate  educational 
tours,
shramadana campaigns and workshops in order to

inculate 
feelings  on  Sri  Lankan  heritage,
environment, wildlife, population and patriotism;
to  provide  assistance  and  to  encourage  forming
scouts groups and platoons in schools;
to  extend  support  to  services  rendered  by  senior
citizens  organizations  and  to  encourage  such
organizations;
to  encourage  farmers  engaged  in  traditional  and
export agricultural activities and to carry out various
awareness programmes for them;
to  take  action  to  provide  required  assistance  and
support and training to unemployed youths in order
to  enable  them  to  engage  in  self  employment
activites;
